target_applications: Astra: manipulation R&D/interactive service; Apollo: logistics case/tote handling, kitting, packout, machine tending

base_type.value: Astra: fixed stand or third-party AMR. Apollo: modular lower body - bipedal legs OR wheeled base OR stationary pedestal (legs-wheels swap <1h per press)

height_mm.source: Astra torso height ~140 cm (aggregated specs); Apollo 1730 mm

dof_total.source: Astra ~24 DoF incl. 12 hand DoF (some sources cite 17) - conflicting third-party figures

payload_per_arm_kg.source: Astra 10 kg per arm (aggregated specs); Apollo total payload 25 kg

torso_lift.value: fixed torso (Astra); Apollo torso on modular base

battery_kwh.source: Apollo: swappable packs, 4 h each (vendor); kWh n/a

runtime_h.source: https://apptronik.com/news-collection/apptronik-unveils-apollo (Apollo, per battery pack; Astra 2-4 h per third-party)

actuators.value: proprietary force-controlled linear/rotary actuators (Valkyrie lineage), claimed 90%+ energy efficiency

end_effector.value: Astra: five-fingered force-controlled hands; Apollo: application grippers / evolving hands

sensors_head.value: head camera/depth perception suite (details not disclosed)

sensors_base.value: hardware-level safety/perimeter zones with impact detection (Apollo)

software_stack.value: Artemis onboard autonomy (perception/planning/controls/safety/HRI); Fleet Connect fleet mgmt; Google DeepMind Gemini Robotics VLA + NVIDIA GR00T; closed platform

safety_compliance.value: hardware safety zones, impact detection, configurable perimeter zones; no published ISO certification

availability.value: Astra: not available (superseded). Apollo: partner pilots only (Mercedes, Jabil, GXO); no open ordering

deployment_evidence.value: Mercedes-Benz factory pilots since Mar 2024; Jabil plant pilot + contract manufacturing; GXO warehouse deployments 2026. All public pilots show LEGGED Apollo; no named customer confirmed on wheeled/pedestal configs as of Aug 2026

notes: Funding: ~$935M staged Series A (2025-2026) at ~$5B valuation; investors incl. Google, Mercedes-Benz, B Capital, John Deere, Qatar Investment Authority. Astra specs vary across third-party sources (17 vs 24 DoF); vendor never published an Astra datasheet. Status 'discontinued' refers to Astra; Apollo wheeled/pedestal variants are 'announced'.
